<subject>SIAM invitation</subject>
<body>
Hôpital Lumière

here is an email invitation for the SIAM event.  A hard copy will follow

Dr. V. Martel  
Lumière Santé SAS  
BP 1188  
Saint-Fons, Lyon 69568-1188

Hôpital Lumière

10 mars 2025

I am writing to formalize your invitation to attend, participate, and speak at the SIAM Regional Healthcare Innovation Workshop. A time slot of thirty minutes is allocated for invited presentations with an additional ten minutes for discussion. The workshop, funded under the auspices of the Santé et Recherche grant to SIAM, will not be a standard healthcare conference with representatives from hospitals, academia, and public health agencies presenting their latest studies. Instead, the meeting will emphasize the clinical innovations and technologies currently applied in private healthcare and research institutions. Additionally, the event will focus on the mechanisms facilitating collaboration and knowledge exchange between hospitals, universities, and public health organizations.

The workshop will be held at the Institut Médico-Légal de Lyon, from 25 to 28 April. The Fondation Lumière will provide support for travel expenses as well as accommodation and meals for invited speakers. We would be happy to assist with travel arrangements if needed.

We hope you can accept our invitation. If so, please send us a presentation title, a brief abstract, and a list of any technical equipment required.

We look forward to welcoming you at the Centre de Conférences Lumière.

Sincerely

Christophe Rivière  
Specialist  
Lumière Santé SAS  
+33 4 72 00 11 22  
25 rue de la Santé  
69007 Lyon
